Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03)
Output: Figure7a-7d in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Main/Figure7` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main/Figure7`; `OUTPUT/TABLES/Figure7.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))
endometriosis <- c("Simple endometriosis", "Atypical endometriosis", "Endometriosis CLE")

# All segments (PanCK, CD3, CD68) of the endometriosis categories
keep <- spe_ruv$Category %in% endometriosis
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]
```

##### Differential expression
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category")
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(ECLE_SE = Endometriosis_CLE - (Simple_endometriosis + Atypical_endometriosis)/2,
                              levels = colnames(design))

efit <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient))$efit

topTable_ECLE <- top_table(efit, "ECLE_SE")
save_tables(mutate(topTable_ECLE, Category = "ECLE"), "Figure7.xlsx")
```

##### Figure 7a
```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 5}
label_genes <- c("S100A9", "S100A8", "S100A7", "HMOX1", "FN1", "ELL2", "TNIP3", "DEFB4B", "C1S", "ALOX5", "CXCL6", "NAMPT",
                 "TNFRSF21", "ADAM28", "CD200", "IGFR2", "TSPAN8")

Figure7a <- plot_volcano(topTable_ECLE, sig_genes_in(topTable_ECLE, label_genes, fc = 0.56),
                         col_low = Category[["Simple endometriosis"]], col_high = Category[["Endometriosis CLE"]], xlim = c(0, 4), ylim = c(0, 3),
                         fc_dashed = 0.56, fc_dotted = 1.5, print_scale = 170 / 360)   # 5 in printed 170 pt wide
Figure7a

save_plot(Figure7a, "Figure7a.svg", width = 5, height = 5)
save_source_data(volcano_source(Figure7a), "Figure7a")
```

##### Figure 7b-c: GSEA, MSigDB Hallmarks and GO biological process
```{r, fig.width = 3.5, fig.height = 4.8}
gene_list <- ranked_logfc(efit, "ECLE_SE")

gseaMsigdbr_ECLE <- gsea_hallmark(gene_list)
# Narrow, tall panels with wrapped terms so the text stays readable on the page (as Figure 2e-f)
Figure7b <- plot_gsea(gseaMsigdbr_ECLE, label_format = 26, right = "ECLE", x_right = 1, caption_size = 2.4) +
  gsea_theme(0.5, 10, nes_breaks = c(0, 1, 2), nes_limits = c(0, 2.6))
Figure7b

save_plot(Figure7b, "Figure7b.svg", width = 3.5, height = 4.8)
save_source_data(gsea_source(gseaMsigdbr_ECLE), "Figure7b")
```

```{r, fig.width = 4.4, fig.height = 7.8}
# GO terms enriched in ECLE only (positive NES)
gseaGO_ECLE <- gsea_go(gene_list)
gseaGO_ECLE@result <- filter(gseaGO_ECLE@result, NES > 0)
Figure7c <- plot_gsea(gseaGO_ECLE, label_format = 45, right = "ECLE", x_right = 1, caption_size = 2.4) +
  gsea_theme(0.6, 10, nes_breaks = c(0, 1, 2), nes_limits = c(0, 2.15)) + scale_size(range = c(1.5, 5))
Figure7c

save_plot(Figure7c, "Figure7c.svg", width = 4.4, height = 7.8)
save_source_data(gsea_source(gseaGO_ECLE), "Figure7c")
```

##### Figure 7d: over-representation of GO terms among genes up in ECLE
```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.2}
sig_ecle <- rownames(subset(topTable_ECLE, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 1.5))
entrez_ecle <- unique(pull(bitr(sig_ecle, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db), ENTREZID))

ego_ecle <- enrichGO(entrez_ecle, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont = "BP", readable = TRUE,
                    pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
ego_ecle@result$Description <- str_to_title(ego_ecle@result$Description)
# enrichGO returns the genes of a term in a run-dependent order; sorted, so the network is the same every run
ego_ecle@result$geneID <- vapply(strsplit(ego_ecle@result$geneID, "/"), function(g) paste(sort(g), collapse = "/"), "")

set.seed(1)  # the network layout is random; fixed for a reproducible figure
Figure7d <- cnetplot(ego_ecle, showCategory = 20, color_category = GO_term_node) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = "Number of genes")) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.title = element_text(size = 11))
# larger node labels (the label layer has no size argument in cnetplot)
for (i in seq_along(Figure7d$layers)) if (inherits(Figure7d$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomTextRepel")) Figure7d$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size <- 3.2
Figure7d

save_plot(Figure7d, "Figure7d.svg", width = 9, height = 5.2)
save_source_data(gsea_source(ego_ecle, show = 20), "Figure7d")
```
